title: Weather Safety Interruptions per Night
dataSources: NINA sequences (`nina:sequence`), NINA autofocus runs (`nina:autofocus`), Ekos scheduler and device events (`ekos:scheduler`, `ekos:device`), PHD2 guiding telemetry (`phd2:guide`), plate solves (`platesolve:run`), filter wheel events (`filterwheel:event`), and flat frames (`flatlib:frame`).
app: Astrophotography session telemetry from N.I.N.A., KStars/Ekos, PHD2, plate-solving tools, ASCOM gear, and filter-wheel controllers sent to Splunk HEC via logs and scripted inputs.
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=ekos:scheduler
| search safety_stop=true
| bin _time span=1d
| stats count as safety_stops by _time reason
| sort - _time
description: Tracks weather safety interruptions over time and breaks it out by reason.
value: Reason-coded safety stops help separate a cautious observatory from one that is frequently losing nights to one flaky sensor or rule.
implementation: Send weather safety interruptions events to `index=personal` with the fields used in the breakdown and review the resulting trend at 1d granularity.
visualization: Stacked time chart of weather safety interruptions by reason.
grandmaExplanation: It keeps how weather safety interruptions changes over time so the busy spells and quiet spells stand out.
